facts.business: Cinevista Limited is engaged in media and entertainment production along with real estate development through joint development agreements.

auditor.name: Raj Niranjan Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-impairment of investments and advances in subsidiaries/associates (Rs. 62.35 lakh and Rs. 3.76 crore) and non-impairment of intangible assets (Rs. 21.89 crore) as required by Ind AS 36.
